text_block_list.text:
One day, while accompanying Maruzensky 
during her dance lessons—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: One-two, one-two, phew, phew! Fin—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm so movedーーーーーーー!! Razor-sharp 
technique! Powerful expression! A perfect 
100 out of 100~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Kya!? What's wrong, Ticket-chan!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Actually, ever since I watched the finals 
of the DanceSport World Championship 
yesterday, I've had dancing on the 
brain...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aha! That's it, Maruzen-san! Could you 
teach me how to dance!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to perform an amazing dance and 
move someone's heart too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, if Ticket-chan's asking, 
totally-obvi! If you're fine with me, 
leave it to yours truly!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!! I'll be in your care--!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"—Hold on, before that! Ticket-chan! If 
you chase two rabbits, you won't catch 
either!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Do you want razor-sharp technical skill? 
Or powerful expressiveness? Let's choose 
one!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhh!! I can't decide!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, then let's have Trainer-kun 
decide on this one♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, then let's have Trainer-chan 
decide on this one♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Let's master that razor-sharp 
choreography!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, try to keep up with my moves! 
Ticket-chan!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be in your care!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup, huuuup! Make sure you use your 
knees~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: E-Eeeek! S-So fast~~~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you're falling a little behind! 
Keep fighting, keep fighting~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Finissssh!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haaaaah~! I'm totally 
exhausteddd~...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your dance moves were super sharp! Totally 
choverig, totally fab~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you so muuuuch...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I feel like being around them helped me 
level up too♪

Teaching Winning Ticket seemed to have 
made Maruzensky's dancing even sharper 
than before!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Roger that, expressiveness it is! Well 
then, let's start by closing our eyes and 
listening closely to the sound!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Ticket-chan, what kind of image do you 
have in your head right now?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"It's a forest! In the forest... there are 
monkeys!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Now open your eyes! I'm gonna 
portray a wild forest monkey with 
everything I've got! Ooh-ooh-aah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiight!! Ukiiiiiiiiii!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, where are you going?! 
Chikezo-cha~n?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eee-hee, eee-hee, 
eee-hee-hee-hee-heeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! I never imagined we'd do a 
full lap around town in monkey 
costumes...! Utterly mind-boggling...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I'm sorry! I was just having sooo 
much fun, I got carried away~~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine! It felt like a good workout 
for me too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's make sure not to forget how today 
felt!

Teaching Winning Ticket seemed to have 
further polished Maruzensky's expressive 
power.
